senses.gloss:
ITA-9.6.144 utkārikākarma (vraṇacikitsā) उत्कारिकाकर्म (व्रणचिकित्सा)
Application of therapeutic warm poultice for wound management
A therapeutic warm poultice resembling a sweet dumpling.

ITA-3.16.37 utkṣepaḥ (marma) उत्क्षेपः (मर्म)
Vulnerable location(s) above the temples
Two in number which when injured by a foreign body may lead to death if it is removed.
